title: Batch Sequence
prompt:
Arrange batches A through I into positions 1 through 9, using every batch exactly once.

Rules:
- B occurs before F.
- C occurs immediately before H.
- I occupies position 4 or 5.
- Exactly one of A and D is among positions 1-3.
- G and H have at least two intervening positions.
- B is not in position 1.
- A occurs before D.
- F occurs before G.
- E is among positions 1-3.

Return one JSON object with this shape:
{"result":{"sequence":["A","B","C","D","E","F","G","H","I"]}}
The sequence must contain every batch exactly once. Any valid sequence is accepted.
